title: HDFC Shoppers Stop Black credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Shoppers Stop Black variant delivering premium shopping rewards, milestone vouchers, and exclusive perks for loyal Shoppers Stop customers.

mileStoneItems.benefits: Earn Rs.2000 per month for a min. purchase of Rs.50,000 on Shoppers Stop over the weekend (capped to maximum once in a month and 5 times in a year)
